content: PRF eval during create() (registration) only ever returns an 'enabled: true/false' capability flag, per spec -- create()'s extension output cannot carry usable PRF secret bytes at all (evalByCredential is a get()-only feature: it maps base64url credential IDs to per-credential eval salts for get() calls with multiple registered credentials). This confirms two-ceremony enrollment (create() to register + detect enabled, then immediate get() with prf.eval.first to obtain real PRF bytes) is not just Bitwarden's implementation choice but a structural requirement of the API shape itself, not a workaround.
